title: Give susi-gawd-agents tests private, never-deleted homes for the global registry and MAC policy
goal: Fix the intermittent susi-gawd-agents lib tests test_external_executor_requires_explicit_invocation (failed in the full Linux workspace run) and openai_chat_peer_requires_api_base (found while repeat-running the crate) at their root: process-global state read from SUSI_HOME must not change or vanish under a test.

decisions.root_cause_fleet: AgentMetaRegistry stores agents in SusiDirs::data_dir()/agent_registry.json, which follows the process's SUSI_HOME. Three fleet tests (fleet_synthesis, external_executor_requires_explicit_invocation, semantic_anchors) register a profile and then read it back through synthesize_fleet without holding SUSI_HOME_TEST_LOCK, while sibling tests (agent_meta_registry, agents_plane_handler, external_peers via EnvGuard) swap SUSI_HOME under that lock, so the register and the read could resolve different homes. Established from the code; this exact failure did not recur in 700+ targeted pre-fix runs (the window is the few milliseconds between register and read).
decisions.root_cause_privacy: In this crate's tests MacPolicy::global() is the wired policy, bound to the SUSI_HOME current at first touch and reading its egress grants and key from that directory on every call. agent_meta_registry's fresh_registry_home reused one per-process directory and deleted it on every call; when the policy had bound to it, the grants vanished, the balanced posture blocked egress, and openai_chat_peer_requires_api_base got [PRIVACY] instead of [UNAVAILABLE]. Reproduced: 1 failure in 80 and 1 in 30 runs of the unmodified binary.
decisions.fix: fresh_registry_home now uses a fresh directory per call and never deletes one; the three registry-touching fleet tests hold SUSI_HOME_TEST_LOCK with a private home for the whole round trip. The fleet unit tests moved verbatim to the crate's src/tests suite directory (the external/mod.rs pattern), so the shipped-line ceiling is respected (susi-gawd-agents 10,447 against 11,263). No assertion, bound or product behaviour changed.

limitations: Both races are timing-dependent; 100 green runs bound but do not prove their absence. The product's check order (privacy gate before the missing-api_base check) is unchanged.

results.host: CachyOS Linux x86_64, busy shared laptop; tests with throwaway HOME/XDG_*/SUSI_HOME, *_API_KEY/HF_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN unset, CARGO_HOME/RUSTUP_HOME real
results.full_run: cargo test --offline --locked --workspace --no-fail-fast on eba6c9fba: 293 test binaries, 5,426 passed, 1 failed (test_external_executor_requires_explicit_invocation), 14 ignored
results.repeat_before: unmodified susi-gawd-agents lib binary: 2 failures in 110 runs (openai_chat_peer_requires_api_base, assertion contains("UNAVAILABLE"))
results.repeat_after: fixed binary, 100 sequential runs: 100 passed (198 tests each)
results.guards: architecture_tests 43, orphan_sources 5, lean_core_ceilings 2, core_docs_promise_no_ui_or_plugins 3: all passed
